title: The future of Arauco
description: A cinematic brand video for Arauco, one of Latin America's largest forestry companies. The piece communicates the company's scale, environmental commitment, and global reach through a powerful combination of landscape cinematography and motion graphics.
challenge: Arauco needed a single video asset that could work across boardroom presentations, LinkedIn, and trade shows simultaneously — communicating both industrial strength and environmental responsibility without compromise.
solution: Built a motion design system around Arauco's existing brand guidelines, layering kinetic typography and data-driven sequences over aerial footage to create a visual narrative that travels from forest to finished product. The result feels premium at any screen size.
result: The video became the centerpiece of Arauco's 2024 investor relations package and their primary LinkedIn content for two consecutive quarters.
